headline: Computational methods refine transcript and protein quantification from RNA data
label: Benchmarking Transcriptomic Analysis Methods
summary: Recent preprints and publications benchmark imputation methods and resolve isoform and transcript-start diversity in single-cell and long-read RNA data.
synthesis: The dominant thread is evaluation of computational transcriptomic and proteomic methods against explicit baselines. Nine machine learning methods for imputing single-cell surface protein expression from scRNA-seq outperform direct mRNA proxies. Related work targets measurement bias and estimation under ambiguity: scATS corrects RNA degradation bias in 5' scRNA-seq to quantify alternative transcription start sites per cell, and PAQu estimates protein isoform abundances under ambiguous peptide mapping with reported uncertainty. A single-cell long-read atlas of glioblastoma prioritizes tumor-restricted isoforms and identifies 6524 unannotated ones. The thread is not universal: sm-PORE-cupine resolves RNA structure ensembles on single molecules through chemical probing and signal alignment, a mechanistic contribution rather than a comparative one.
